description:
[FREE] Read the SolvScore micro-limit ladder for one wallet.

Returns the published rungs ($10 starter, then $25 / $50 / $100 / $250 as repayments
are recorded), this wallet's current rung and limit, its recent ladder events, and
any underwriting decision once it graduates. A wallet with no attestation reads as
no ladder at all — that is the honest answer, not an error.
name: get_credit_ladder
